name: haril-ts
description: File-lifecycle reconstruction for Windows, in Bun + TypeScript

scripts.build:js: bun build packages/cli/src/cli.ts --outfile dist/haril.js --target node --format esm --packages=external
scripts.build:standalone: bun run embed:native && bun build packages/cli/src/cli.ts --compile --windows-icon=assets/icon.ico --windows-title="Haril-TS" --windows-description="File-lifecycle reconstruction for Windows" --outfile dist/haril.exe
scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:native && bun run build:native:arm64 && bun run build:standalone
